\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 159-162 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R167-first-pass-words-from-chapters-159-162}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to escape and to disappear.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to wake up, to go up, to arrive, to travel, to cross
  \item to taste, to pour, to switch off, to fill, to bathe
  \item to sneeze, to breathe, to break, to rest, to feel
  \item to print, to copy, to move, to register, to employ
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To wake up? (\textbf{\ar{استيقظ}}, \emph{istayqaẓa}.) To go up? (\textbf{\ar{صعد}}, \emph{ṣaʿida}.) To arrive? (\textbf{\ar{وصل}}, \emph{waṣala}.) To travel? (\textbf{\ar{سافر}}, \emph{sāfara}.) To cross? (\textbf{\ar{عبر}}, \emph{ʿabara}.) To taste? (\textbf{\ar{ذاق}}, \emph{dhāqa}.) To pour? (\textbf{\ar{صب}}, \emph{ṣabba}.) To switch off? (\textbf{\ar{أطفأ}}, \emph{aṭfaʾa}.) To fill? (\textbf{\ar{ملأ}}, \emph{malaʾa}.) To bathe? (\textbf{\ar{استحم}}, \emph{istaḥamma}.) To sneeze? (\textbf{\ar{عطس}}, \emph{ʿaṭasa}.) To breathe? (\textbf{\ar{تنفس}}, \emph{tanaffasa}.) To break? (\textbf{\ar{كسر}}, \emph{kasara}.) To rest? (\textbf{\ar{استراح}}, \emph{istarāḥa}.) To feel? (\textbf{\ar{أحس}}, \emph{aḥassa}.) To print? (\textbf{\ar{طبع}}, \emph{ṭabaʿa}.) To copy? (\textbf{\ar{نسخ}}, \emph{nasakha}.) To move? (\textbf{\ar{انتقل}}, \emph{intaqala}.) To register? (\textbf{\ar{سجل}}, \emph{sajjala}.) To employ? (\textbf{\ar{وظف}}, \emph{waẓẓafa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 163-167 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R167-second-pass-words-from-chapters-163-167}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to celebrate and to invite.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to celebrate, to invite, to marry, to shake hands with, to hug
  \item to shout, to pray, to joke, to believe, to remember
  \item to delete, to begin, to end, to continue, to finish
  \item to hunt, to build, to knock down, to paint, to hide
  \item to trip, to slip, to rescue, to escape, to disappear
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To celebrate? (\textbf{\ar{احتفل}}, \emph{iḥtafala}.) To invite? (\textbf{\ar{دعا}}, \emph{daʿā}.) To marry? (\textbf{\ar{تزوج}}, \emph{tazawwaja}.) To shake hands with? (\textbf{\ar{صافح}}, \emph{ṣāfaḥa}.) To hug? (\textbf{\ar{عانق}}, \emph{ʿānaqa}.) To shout? (\textbf{\ar{صرخ}}, \emph{ṣarakha}.) To pray? (\textbf{\ar{صلى}}, \emph{ṣallā}.) To joke? (\textbf{\ar{مزح}}, \emph{mazaḥa}.) To believe? (\textbf{\ar{اعتقد}}, \emph{iʿtaqada}.) To remember? (\textbf{\ar{تذكر}}, \emph{tadhakkara}.) To delete? (\textbf{\ar{حذف}}, \emph{ḥadhafa}.) To begin? (\textbf{\ar{بدأ}}, \emph{badaʾa}.) To end? (\textbf{\ar{انتهى}}, \emph{intahā}.) To continue? (\textbf{\ar{استمر}}, \emph{istamarra}.) To finish? (\textbf{\ar{أنهى}}, \emph{anhā}.) To hunt? (\textbf{\ar{صاد}}, \emph{ṣāda}.) To build? (\textbf{\ar{بنى}}, \emph{banā}.) To knock down? (\textbf{\ar{هدم}}, \emph{hadama}.) To paint? (\textbf{\ar{دهن}}, \emph{dahana}.) To hide? (\textbf{\ar{خبأ}}, \emph{khabbaʾa}.) To trip? (\textbf{\ar{تعثر}}, \emph{taʿaththara}.) To slip? (\textbf{\ar{انزلق}}, \emph{inzalaqa}.) To rescue? (\textbf{\ar{أنقذ}}, \emph{anqadha}.) To escape? (\textbf{\ar{هرب}}, \emph{haraba}.) To disappear? (\textbf{\ar{اختفى}}, \emph{ikhtafā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
